title: Fixsen's 2009 abstract: CMB temperature 2.72548 ± 0.00057 K
summary: The abstract gives a literature determination of 2.72548 ± 0.00057 K, and a separate FIRAS recalibration of 2.7260 ± 0.0013 K.
body: D. J. Fixsen's abstract, on the arXiv record 0911.1955, says a FIRAS recalibration using WMAP data gives a CMB temperature of 2.7260 ± 0.0013 K, and that the determination from the measurements in the literature is a cosmic microwave background temperature of 2.72548 ± 0.00057 K. Both numbers are in that abstract. They are not the same analysis. This card does not pick a third value.
